_why: TASK-806 (REQ-121). One test file: the clicked teacher-form picker test. Written with the set; nothing reconstructed.

mutations.what: 🔴 REVERT to the roster union: the catalog is the programs some teacher already has again — a DUO program on no teacher can never be ticked

edits.from: const subjectCatalog = useMemo(() => (subjects.data?.subjects ?? []).map((s) => ({ value: s.id, label: s.name })), [subjects.data]);
edits.to: const subjectCatalog = useMemo(() => { const m = new Map<string, string>(); for (const tc of teachers) for (const s of tc.subjectOptions ?? []) m.set(s.id, s.name); return [...m.entries()].map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label })); }, [teachers]);

mutations.what: 🔴 the loading guard is dropped: the teacher's OWN programs are no longer kept in `data`, so while the list loads an Edit shows no ticks
🔴 the DUO programs are filtered out of the catalog (the other pickers' §13.4a rule leaks into the teacher form)
🔴 the Edit is not seeded from the teacher's own programs — Save sends an empty list and wipes them
